description: Details of condition 9 Part A (BREEAM Design Stage Certificate and summary score sheet) submitted pursuant to planning permission 00094/AP/P2 approved 30/08/2017 for Variation of condition 9 (BREEAM Certificates) to be produced within 11 weeks instead of prior to first occupation following planning permission 00094/AP/P1 dated 13/01/2017 for proposed new build single storey Pupil Referral unit (PRU) pimary SEN school for 30 pupils year age 4-11. The proposal comprise of Early Years, Key Stage 1 and Key Stage 2 classrooms, learning and support facilities for pupils and staffs, multi purpose hall, storages, plant room and server room. Proposed 2.4 m high anti-climb fencing all around site with sliding metal gate for vehicular access and secured metal gates for pedestrian access/exit, basketball hoops and 5.2 m metal fencing all around the court, detached roof canopy of 50sqm covered area at rear and proposed car park area on front.
